usedFor: Bexio holds quotes, orders and invoices, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer when “New Order” appears.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Bexio, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Each new order starts a command you have set up on your own computer.

watchOut: “New Quote” in Bexio fires on updates as well as new quotes, so one quote can run “Trigger Command” twice.
